conditions.name: Acute Liver Failure
conditions.description: Rapid loss of liver function in patients without pre-existing liver disease

medications.notes: N-acetylcysteine (NAC). Standard antidote for acetaminophen-induced acute liver failure. Also studied in non-acetaminophen ALF. IV or oral formulations.

medications.notes: IBAT (ileal bile acid transporter) inhibitor for cholestatic pruritus. FDA-approved for Alagille syndrome (≥3 months) and PFIC (≥12 months). Reduces serum bile acids and pruritus.

conditions.name: Cholangiocarcinoma
conditions.description: Cancer of the bile ducts, intrahepatic and extrahepatic

conditions.name: Cirrhosis
conditions.description: End-stage scarring from any chronic liver disease; cross-cutting management of complications

medications.notes: Long-acting non-selective beta-blocker for variceal bleed prophylaxis in cirrhosis. Alternative to propranolol with once-daily dosing.
Oral alpha-1 agonist for orthostatic hypotension and hepatorenal syndrome (HRS-2 outpatient management). Used in cirrhosis to manage refractory ascites and HRS.
Somatostatin analog for acute variceal bleeding in cirrhosis. Reduces portal pressure and splanchnic blood flow. Also used for hepatorenal syndrome.
Synthetic vasopressin analog for hepatorenal syndrome (HRS-1 / HRS-AKI). FDA-approved September 2022 — first US treatment for HRS. IV administration in hospital setting.

conditions.name: Hemochromatosis
conditions.description: Iron overload disorder, hereditary or secondary, with hepatic and systemic manifestations

medications.notes: Oral iron chelator for chronic iron overload from transfusions or non-transfusion-dependent thalassemia. Used in secondary hemochromatosis. Generic available — patients routed to GoodRx/Cost Plus Drugs/SingleCare via discount programs rather than manufacturer copay/PAP.
Parenteral iron chelator for acute iron poisoning and chronic iron overload. Older agent; deferasirox is preferred for chronic use due to oral administration.

conditions.name: Hepatic Encephalopathy
conditions.description: Neurocognitive complication of cirrhosis and liver failure

medications.notes: Minimal systemic absorption; used in Crohns
First-line treatment for hepatic encephalopathy. Reduces ammonia absorption. Often used in combination with rifaximin.
